#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Compiles circuits/range.circom to R1CS + WASM witness generator in build/.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"

command -v circom >/dev/null || { echo "error: circom not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
command -v npm    >/dev/null || { echo "error: npm not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; }

# Fetch circomlib (pinned in package.json / package-lock.json).
if [[ -f package-lock.json ]]; then
    npm ci --silent --no-audit --no-fund
else
    npm install --silent --no-audit --no-fund
fi

mkdir -p build
circom circuits/range.circom --r1cs --wasm --sym -l node_modules -o build

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Usage: bash prove.sh input.json
# Exits 0 iff a witness satisfying the circuit's constraints can be generated.
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")"

if [[ $# -ne 1 ]]; then
    echo "usage: $0 input.json" >&2
    exit 2
fi

input="$1"
[[ "$input" = /* ]] || input="$OLDPWD/$input"

wasm_dir=build/range_js
if [[ ! -f "$wasm_dir/range.wasm" ]]; then
    echo "error: circuit not built; run build.sh first" >&2
    exit 2
fi

wtns="$(mktemp -t range-wtns.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -f "$wtns"' EXIT

node "$wasm_dir/generate_witness.js" "$wasm_dir/range.wasm" "$input" "$wtns"
